upstream_snapshot.title: Welcome Edgard Kagan
author: Anne Neuberger
upstream_snapshot.selection_reason: 这篇官方任命公告切入一个适合创业团队的问题：国际化不只是翻译界面，还包括理解谁能推动当地实际采用。

segments.en: a16z says it wants to help portfolio companies understand what governments and customers in different Indo-Pacific markets need. It has brought former U.S. diplomat Edgard Kagan in as a Global Affairs advisor.
segments.zh: a16z 表示，希望帮助被投企业理解印太各市场的政府与客户需求，并邀请前美国外交官埃德加德·卡根担任全球事务顾问。

segments.en: The announcement points to Kagan's experience in Malaysia and elsewhere in the region. It presents that background as a way for founders to understand who makes decisions and which local relationships may help a technology gain acceptance.
segments.zh: 公告以卡根在马来西亚及该地区其他地方的经历为依据，认为这些经验能帮助创业者理解决策者是谁，以及哪些当地合作关系可能促进技术落地。

analysis.core_thesis: 公告把地区知识和合作关系视为技术进入新市场的条件，而不是工程完成后才处理的附属工作。
supporting_evidence: 公告明确区分各市场的需求与决策方式，并把顾问经验与被投企业的合作问题联系起来。
industry_significance: 跨境产品验证应把使用者、采购方和审批方分别列出。产品演示得到使用者认可，不代表预算或合规审批已就绪。
limitations: 这是一份任命公告，没有公布试点结果、采购周期、采用率或具体合作安排，不能据此判断顾问能否改变商业结果。
analysis.independent_judgment: 先挑一个市场和场景，列出采购发起人、审批方和本地实施负责人，再把下一个可验证的采购节点写下来。比起统计见了多少合作方，能否确认试点负责人和下一步承诺更有判断力。

vocabulary.example_en: Reliable connectivity underpins many public services.
vocabulary.example_zh: 可靠的网络连接为许多公共服务奠定基础。

vocabulary.example_en: The two markets have distinct procurement rules.
vocabulary.example_zh: 这两个市场的采购规则各不相同。

vocabulary.example_en: Data residency is a priority for the agency.
vocabulary.example_zh: 数据驻留是该机构的优先事项。

vocabulary.example_en: The team's mission is to make the service easier to access.
vocabulary.example_zh: 团队的使命是降低服务的使用门槛。

vocabulary.example_en: The partnership pairs a software vendor with a local operator.
vocabulary.example_zh: 这项合作将软件供应商与本地运营商连接起来。

vocabulary.example_en: A pilot does not guarantee adoption across an entire agency.
vocabulary.example_zh: 试点不保证整个机构都会采用。

vocabulary.example_en: Training can strengthen a partner's ability to support customers.
vocabulary.example_zh: 培训可以增强合作伙伴支持客户的能力。

vocabulary.example_en: The ambassador spoke about trade at the forum.
vocabulary.example_zh: 大使在论坛上谈到了贸易。

vocabulary.example_en: Diplomatic experience can help a team interpret local policy.
vocabulary.example_zh: 外交经验有助于团队理解当地政策。

vocabulary.example_en: The team consulted regional partners before choosing a pilot site.
vocabulary.example_zh: 团队在选定试点地点前咨询了地区合作伙伴。

notes: No same-day original selection JSON was available; prepared independently from the official publication.
